Class BuildingCardPickedDelta

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.delta.GameDelta
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.delta.BuildingCardPickedDelta
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BuildingCardPickedDelta extends GameDelta
GameDelta sent when a player picks a building card from the shared "showed" rows. It conveys which card was taken, the refreshed building rows, the player's updated food and prestige points, whether the player returned their totem (i.e. finished picking) and the resulting game phase.

    • BuildingCardPickedDelta

      public BuildingCardPickedDelta(String playerNickname, String cardId, List<String> updatedUpperBuildingIds, List<String> updatedLowerBuildingIds, int updatedFood, int updatedPoints, boolean totemReturned, String currentPhase)
      Creates a new building-card-picked delta.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player who picked the card
      cardId - the identifier of the picked building card
      updatedUpperBuildingIds - the refreshed upper "showed" building row
      updatedLowerBuildingIds - the refreshed lower "showed" building row
      updatedFood - the player's food after paying for the building and returning the totem
      updatedPoints - the player's prestige points after any food penalty
      totemReturned - true if the player has finished their picks and the totem has been returned
      currentPhase - the game phase after applying this delta
